LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill.label: crust driller
LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill.description: The final upgrade of the deep drilling systems, the crust driller goes deep into the planetary crust to extract valuable resources.
LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill_II.label: kwazaari crust driller
LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill_II.description: An upgraded crust driller built from kwazaari-grade materials. It supports coordinated multi-operator drilling from all cardinal approach angles.
LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill_III.label: tenebral autonomous crust driller
LanguageData.BOR_ResourceDrill_III.description: A fully automated deep extraction platform. It no longer requires direct pawn operation and continuously processes selected deep resources.
LanguageData.BOR_Mine.label: tenebral autonomous mine
LanguageData.BOR_Mine.description: A self-running mine that burns its way down with a concentrated beam. It needs no operators, and reaches the depths between the kwazaari driller's limit and the point where the tenebral driller starts.
